payload.note: The public cross-CCR and finite-volume delta convention give exact positive spectator norm N_s=2*E_s*V. Normalizing the two external spectator legs cancels this factor in the disconnected identity tree but divides the connected tree by N_s. The certified external-jet cross therefore becomes a dimensionless tagged finite-volume contribution with q_cross/q_tag^(4)=2*sqrt(2)*lambda^2*W_kappa(T)/(3*N_s). At E_s=6*kappa/5 it is 125*sqrt(2)*lambda^6*W_kappa(T)*DeltaOmega/(12288*pi^2*kappa^3*Area*V). It vanishes as 1/V at fixed finite T but grows as T/V at fixed V; the controlling double-scaling variable is T/(kappa^2*V). This is the tree-cross part only, not the complete lambda6 probability.
